title: Indianapolis-Area Public Parcel Candidate Geometry
privacy_note: Public-safe screening geometry. Owner names, addresses, and parcel identifiers are excluded.
selection_logic: Largest source polygons by SHAPE__Area, then geodesically measured and filtered to 20+ acres; capped at 12 per county. Verify boundaries and acreage with the county before use.

properties.note: Screening geometry only. Acres are calculated geodesically from the public polygon; owner, address, and parcel ID fields are excluded.
